description.value: Belle's Café is a long-established neighbourhood café in South Surrey's Elgin Park area, proudly scratch-cooking almost everything — from soups and meatballs to baked goods free of chemicals and preservatives — since 1999. The café is well known for its handcrafted coffee, seasonal baked treats, and an unusually broad range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options across both its eat-in and take-away menus. Touring cyclists will find a cozy, community-minded stop with house-made frozen dinners available to grab on the way out.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Belle's is an active neighbourhood café at 14007 32 Ave, Surrey, operating since 1999; address and phone match OSM. The site explicitly states 'We have many vegetarian, gluten-free, and even vegan options' and the menu is labelled with V/GF/DF markers throughout, and the frozen-food and 'grab one to go' language confirms takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. OSM name 'Belle's' differs from the website's consistent branding 'Belle's Café', and OSM opening hours differ from those listed on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Belle's' but the website consistently uses 'Belle's Café' — the OSM record may be missing the full name.
OSM opening hours (Tu-Fr 09:00-17:00; Sa 10:00-16:00) differ from the website's listed hours (Mon-Fri 7:30am-5pm; Sat 8am-5pm) — OSM hours appear outdated or incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Belle's is a real, active, publicly accessible café with a confirmed website, address, and phone number. It offers food and drink relevant to touring cyclists including takeout and a wide range of dietary options.
